Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
I shall be very happy to receive [£50 ](../others.html#160)for the American copyright of [‘A Long Vacation’](../books.html#237)

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed \'Brett has agreed to pay £60 vide his letter of Dec 24/94\'.
